note: MT ke'otyah "like one veiling herself" (perhaps as a prostitute, cf. Gen 38:14); the KJV follows the versions' reading ketho'iyyah "like a wanderer".

kjv: a company of horses in Pharaoh's chariots
note: Hebrew susati is "my mare"; chariot teams were stallions, so a mare among them causes a stir, a vivid compliment lost in "company of horses".
